_comment: Editorial: why a company has no configured event source, from the 2026-10-01/02
event-source research (its own site, sitemaps, platforms, blogs, university calendars).
reason: board = programs are caught on its job board; page-only = a static program page,
no list (page-change alerts are deliberately not built); browser = list drawn by JavaScript;
no-list = no upcoming list in the HTML; blocked = refused or prohibited; none = nothing public.

AQR Capital Management.note: Info sessions appear only on university calendars and Handshake.

Adobe.note: adobe.com/events timed out; careers events are talent-community sign-ups, not events.

Airbnb.note: Connect is an apprenticeship for non-degree engineers, not a student program.

Akuna Capital.note: Info-session sign-ups are on akunacapital.hiringplatform.com, whose robots.txt disallows everything.

Amazon.note: Info sessions appear only on university calendars and Handshake (sign-in).

Anduril.note: anduril.com/early-careers renders with JavaScript; info sessions are on university calendars and Handshake.

Apple.note: apple.com/apple-events lists past keynotes only; new ones are announced days ahead.

Applied Intuition.note: Students or early-careers pages exist but list no events.

Boston Dynamics.note: Events page lists only a 2023 event.

ByteDance / TikTok.note: TechJam and info sessions are APAC/EMEA, which the US filter would drop.

Chicago Trading Company.note: Campus page links to a virtual-events site (recsolu.com) this environment could not reach.

Cloudflare.note: cloudflare.com/events loads its list with JavaScript.

Coinbase.note: coinbase.com/events loads its list with JavaScript.

Confluent.note: The Luma calendar named Confluent appears to be run by a third-party group.

DE Shaw.note: deshaw.com/careers/events renders its list with JavaScript.

DRW.note: Only blog posts and a third-party list (openquant.co) mention Discover DRW.

Datadog.note: datadoghq.com/events-webinars loads its list with JavaScript.

DoorDash.note: AI Research Fellowship is posted on its Greenhouse board; the company site answers 403.

Figure.note: Students or early-careers pages exist but list no events.

Five Rings.note: LINK intensive program is posted on its Greenhouse board; robots.txt disallows crawling the site.

Goldman Sachs.note: Apprentice programmes are posted on higher.gs.com; goldmansachs.com answers 403.

Google.note: robots.txt disallows google.com/careers and /events; the student site needs a browser.

Hudson River Trading.note: Student opportunities page describes programs in prose; no list to read.

IMC Trading.note: Chess Academy interest forms are on its Greenhouse board. The US events page renders client-side; the readable campus pages are APAC-only.

Jump Trading.note: Fellowship page only; no list of events.

LinkedIn.note: Its events are on linkedin.com, which needs a sign-in and whose terms prohibit automated collection.

Mercury.note: mercury.com/events loads its list with JavaScript.

Meta.note: robots.txt forbids automated collection without written permission.

Millennium.note: Meet Millennium page only. Its events are Eightfold pages with no public list, so new ones cannot be discovered.

Mistral AI.note: Students or early-careers pages exist but list no events.

MongoDB.note: Runs 'MongoDB Summits' but no public page lists them.

Notion.note: Students or early-careers pages exist but list no events.

Palantir.note: Neurodivergent Fellowship is posted on its Lever board; palantir.com/events renders client-side.

Palo Alto Networks.note: Events appear only on Prosple, a graduate-events site, with none listed.

Perplexity AI.note: Research Fellowship is posted on its Ashby board; the company site answers 403.

Point72.note: Academy case competition, insight programme and coffee chats are posted on its Greenhouse board.

Radix Trading.note: Students or early-careers pages exist but list no events.

Ramp.note: Webinars only; its Luma calendar is empty.

Reddit.note: Students or early-careers pages exist but list no events.

Replit.note: Students or early-careers pages exist but list no events.

Robinhood.note: robinhood.com/careers/events loads its list with JavaScript.

Roblox.note: careers.roblox.com timed out on every attempt.

Schonfeld.note: A PhD summit is mentioned only in news posts; its sophomore internships are on its job board.

ServiceNow.note: careers.servicenow.com/events loads its list with JavaScript.

Shield AI.note: Students or early-careers pages exist but list no events.

Sierra.note: Early career program page and a customer summit page; no list.

Snap.note: Snap Academies lists dated info sessions seasonally (March-April); empty on 2026-10-02, so its markup could not be checked. Add it when sessions are listed.

Snowflake.note: snowflake.com/events shows world-tour cards without names in the HTML; its careers events list (Phenom) is empty; no Luma calendar found.

SpaceX.note: spacex.com/careers renders with JavaScript; info sessions are on university calendars and Handshake.

Stripe.note: Recruits through ColorStack, Rewriting the Code, Grace Hopper and AfroTech; no list of its own.

Susquehanna International Group.note: Discovery Programs are posted on its Jibe board; careers.sig.com/events needs a browser.

Toyota Research Institute.note: Students or early-careers pages exist but list no events.

Uber.note: Uber Career Prep fellowship page only; its events page is Uber for Business marketing.

Waymo.note: Students or early-careers pages exist but list no events.
